name: Pull relay mail spool
description: Dials out over WireGuard to the hardened ingest relay, rsyncs new sealed message blobs off its spool (copy-only), stores each durably (Standard/Private opened and ingested now; Fortress stored pending-parse for the next unlock), then deletes the entries it durably stored as the ack. Runs every cron pass (every_run) as the short poll. No-op on colocated deployments.
